title: fix(cli): os validate --strict promotes warnings, never info findings
body:
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate --strict` 只把 warning（及 error）判为失败；规则注册表里 `info` 级别的发现仍然打印（改用蓝色 `ℹ`，与 `os lint` 一致）、仍留在 `--json` 的 `warnings` 里，但不再让 `--strict` 退出 1。
- 为什么改：执行维护者裁决记录 6787890900：`--strict` 提升的是 warning，不是 info；与 `os lint --strict` 的语义对齐。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽——原本因 info 失败的 CI 现在会通过；转换通知、文档、未声明键、能力、结构类警告照旧拦截。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts`（`strictFailing` 的计数与两处读取它的出口），`packages/cli/src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts`（新 describe），`.changeset/validate-strict-info-advisory.md`。
- 两分钟验证：在一个只有 info 发现的栈（私有对象 + 授予 `allowRead` 但无 `readScope` 的权限集）上跑 `os validate --strict`，预期退出 0、看到一行 `ℹ`、没有 `Strict mode: warnings treated as errors`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `os validate --strict` fails the run on warnings and errors only. One count, `strictFailing` (every entry of the text face's warning list except rule-registry findings with `severity === 'info'`), is read by both the `--json` exit status and the text face's strict verdict, so the two faces cannot disagree.
- An `info` finding is still printed, now under a blue `ℹ` (the glyph `os lint` gives the same finding as a `suggestion`), and still rides the `--json` payload's `warnings`. An info-only run prints no `Strict mode: warnings treated as errors` line.
- Conversion notices, `warning`-severity registry findings, doc, undeclared-key, capability-provider and structural advisories keep gating `--strict` exactly as before.
- The `--strict` flag text, `packages/cli/README.md` and `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` say that `--strict` promotes warnings and that `info` stays advisory.
- Changeset (`@objectstack/cli`, patch) names the info rule ids that stop gating, by their `@objectstack/lint` exports: `SECURITY_PRIVATE_NO_READSCOPE`, `SECURITY_ROLLUP_SOURCE_ROW_SCOPED`, `ASSIGNMENT_RULE_QUEUE_UNSTAFFED`, `APPROVAL_APPROVERS_MAY_RESOLVE_EMPTY`, `APPROVAL_EXPRESSION_NO_EMPTY_POLICY`, and the `info` arm of `APPROVAL_EXPRESSION_INVALID`. These are the seven `severity: 'info'` push sites under `packages/lint/src` on `origin/main`; the four `suggestion`-to-`info` maps in `authoring-rules.ts` wrap rules that emit only `error`/`warning`.

## Tests

- `src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts`: new top-level describe, a minimal pair from one template. The info member (a permission set granting `allowRead` on a private object with no `readScope`) raises exactly one `info` finding and exits 0 under `--strict` on both faces, prints it under `ℹ`, and claims no strict verdict. The warning member (a tool declaring the experimental `outputSchema`) raises exactly one `warning` and exits 1 under `--strict` on both faces with the verdict line. A third case holds both members at 0 without `--strict`.
- `test/validate-json-warning-parity.e2e.test.ts`: the text-face reader accepts both advisory glyphs, since an `info` finding is in the payload's `warnings` too.
- One-shot ablation: red, then restored (counts under Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- `*.e2e.test.ts` files in `packages/cli` run in the nightly tier (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`), not in per-PR or merge-queue runs. The new describe lives in the existing `--strict` harness file; it was run locally under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`.
- `os lint` already grades these findings as suggestions that `--strict` leaves advisory; this change makes `os validate` agree. `packages/lint` is untouched.
